title: Optimizing the basal application dosage of ZnO nanoparticles for enhancing rice yield, rice quality, and zinc content
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2687-2698
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00229J, Paper
Haipeng Zhang, Xijun Yuan, Xinyue Liu, Jie Chen, Rui Wang, Hongcheng Zhang, Yanju Yang
ZnO NPs are increasingly used as an innovative Zn fertilizer in agriculture. This study highlights the potential of ZnO NPs for improving rice yield, quality and grain Zn content compared to zinc sulfate.
